item.text: {"summary":"The draft is mostly publishable, but its prior and interval lean on announced-award proxies rather than the same USAspending transaction-obligation series, which should be tightened or explicitly caveated.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"warning","summary":"The historical sample uses CDFI award announcements and appropriation figures rather than prior-year values from the registered USAspending spending_over_time query.","actionRequested":"Add same-resolver historical USAspending values for available prior fiscal years, or explicitly state that the same-query history could not be obtained and that the award-announcement sample is only a proxy."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The interval sigma is computed from a three-point proxy sample mixing FY2024 awards, FY2025 planned funding, and FY2026 appropriation, not realized volatility of the target series.","actionRequested":"Either base the interval on realized volatility from same-query historical obligations or clearly label the current sigma as proxy uncertainty and justify why 320-860 is calibrated to target risk."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Clarify whether Capital Magnet Fund obligations are expected to appear under the registered CDFI awarding-subagency and award-type query, since that component materially drives the FY2024 persistence prior.","Avoid saying the lower bound is constrained by authorized minima unless those minima are likely to obligate within FY2026 under the registered transaction timing rule."]}
